experiment: detour-share follow-up: which difference from the ladder baseline lets the demonstrations act -- hazard density (A) or discount (B)
git: b8816b8e4810708ff6b76a54bef468bb45c48b88 + uncommitted: scripts/run_v6_branch_replay.py (V6_DISCOUNT override), scripts/exp_v6_detour_ratio.py (report key fix)
motivation: notes/v6_detour_ladder.md section 5: the frozen V6 baseline (p_active 0.40, gamma 0.99, critic + actor jointly from scratch, 100k, bc 0.05) never detours on the 0.30 rung (mean policy 0.000 on seeds 0-2, sampled <= 0.017); the detour-share experiment's d20 vanilla chain (p_active 0.50, gamma 0.999, frozen 30k critic, actor from the BC walker, bc 0.05, 30k, balanced rows) detours 0.51 / 0.74 / 0.63.  Four differences; this follow-up isolates two of them with the recorded-futures chain only (no branch replay).

A_density.chain: pure BC 100k (seed 0, fresh) -> BC 300-draw eval -> vanilla critics x3 (30k) -> actors x3 (BC init, frozen critic, bc 0.05, 30k) -> 300-draw mean evals
A_density.reference: d20 vanilla (p050, gamma 0.999): success 0.543 / 0.723 / 0.647, detour 0.507 / 0.737 / 0.630; ladder baseline 0.30 rung: detour 0.000

B_discount.bc_init: joint_purebc_d20/seed_0/final.pkl (the d20 BC walker; BC does not depend on the discount)
B_discount.chain: vanilla critics x3 (30k, gamma 0.99) -> actors x3 (d20 BC init, frozen critic, bc 0.05, 30k, gamma 0.99) -> 300-draw mean evals
B_discount.reference: d20 vanilla at gamma 0.999 (same node, same BC init, same seeds)

C_share10.nested: same selection seed 2028 and pool as the sealed d05 / d20 draws (d05 detour episodes subset of d10 subset of d20; shortcut episodes d20 subset of d10 subset of d05); d05 / d20 files untouched
C_share10.chain: recorded-futures chain as in A: pure BC 100k (seed 0, fresh) -> BC 300-draw eval -> vanilla critics x3 (30k, gamma 0.999) -> actors x3 (BC init, frozen critic, bc 0.05, 30k) -> 300-draw mean evals; no branch replay
C_share10.reference: d05 vanilla 0.263 / 0.263 / 0.260 (detour 0.07 / 0.01 / 0.01) and d20 vanilla 0.543 / 0.723 / 0.647 (detour 0.51 / 0.74 / 0.63); question: where between 5% and 20% the recorded-futures chain starts choosing the detour; no prediction registered

fixed: everything else as in manifest.json: 8-d single-step torque, NCE + original actor loss, bc 0.05, balanced BC rows, 30k critic / 30k actor, eval seed 909, mean policy, no sweeps; no branch replay in this follow-up

decision_rules.effect: mean over 3 seeds differs from the reference by > 2 x pooled seed s.e. with 3 / 3 seeds in the same direction (success and detour rate)
decision_rules.A: A detours like d20 vanilla (no effect vs the reference) -> the hazard density is not what separates this chain from the ladder baseline; A at ~0 detour -> density (or the p040 collection) matters
decision_rules.B: B falls to ~0 detour (effect vs d20 vanilla, negative) -> the discount is the unlocking difference; B detours like d20 vanilla -> the discount is not it, the remaining candidates are the critic schedule and the actor initialisation / sampling
decision_rules.ceiling_arithmetic_prediction: gamma 0.99: shortcut 0.37 x 0.157 = 0.058 vs detour 0.99 x 0.040 = 0.040 at p040 (shortcut preferred), 0.041 vs 0.040 at p050 (tie); gamma 0.999: 0.31 vs 0.72 (p040), 0.21 vs 0.72 (p050) -- prediction: A detours, B does not.  Stated before the run.
decision_rules.C: descriptive: report success and detour rate per seed against d05 and d20 with the same 2 s.e. / 3-of-3 rule for each pairwise difference; an intermediate result (some seeds detour) is reported as such
